SELECT r.ret_reg, r.retain_engage_pivot, e.engage_member_pivot, m.member_fan_pivot 
FROM retentionandinfluence r 
JOIN engagement e ON r.retain_engage_pivot = e.engage_reg 
JOIN membershipandspending m ON e.engage_member_pivot = m.member_reg 
LIMIT 5;

SELECT r.ret_reg, 
       r.infl_impact->>'Viral_Cont' as viral_cont,
       r.infl_impact->>'Trend_Part' as trend_part,
       r.infl_impact->>'Cont_Reach' as cont_reach,
       r.infl_impact->>'Fing_Count' as fing_count,
       r.infl_impact->>'Foll_Count' as foll_count
FROM retentionandinfluence r 
LIMIT 5;

SELECT s.social_reg, 
       s.network_stats->>'Fing_Count' as fing_count,
       s.network_stats->>'Foll_Count' as foll_count,
       s.network_stats->>'Friend_Con' as friend_con
FROM socialcommunity s LIMIT 5;

SELECT s.social_reg, s.social_engage_pivot, e.engage_member_pivot, m.member_fan_pivot
FROM socialcommunity s
JOIN engagement e ON s.social_engage_pivot = e.engage_reg
JOIN membershipandspending m ON e.engage_member_pivot = m.member_reg
LIMIT 5;

SELECT f.nick_label,
       r.infl_impact->>'Viral_Cont'::int as viral_cont,
       r.infl_impact->>'Trend_Part'::int as trend_part,
       s.network_stats->>'Foll_Count'::int as foll_count,
       r.infl_impact->>'Cont_Reach'::int as cont_reach,
       (r.infl_impact->>'Viral_Cont'::int) * (1 + (r.infl_impact->>'Trend_Part'::int)) as vps,
       sqrt((s.network_stats->>'Foll_Count'::numeric) * (r.infl_impact->>'Cont_Reach'::numeric)) as cii
FROM fans f
JOIN membershipandspending m ON f.user_registry = m.member_fan_pivot
JOIN engagement e ON m.member_reg = e.engage_member_pivot
JOIN retentionandinfluence r ON e.engage_reg = r.retain_engage_pivot
JOIN socialcommunity s ON e.engage_reg = s.social_engage_pivot
WHERE (r.infl_impact->>'Viral_Cont'::int) * (1 + (r.infl_impact->>'Trend_Part'::int)) > 50
  AND sqrt((s.network_stats->>'Foll_Count'::numeric) * (r.infl_impact->>'Cont_Reach'::numeric)) BETWEEN 1000 AND 10000
LIMIT 20;
